answer: India's current repo rate, set by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), is 5.50% [2][6]. It was last changed on 7 October 2026, when the Monetary Policy Committee raised the rate by 25 basis points—the first hike in over 3.5 years [2][5][6]. The hike was attributed to rising inflation, higher oil prices, and a weaker rupee [6].
